title: Store.findTool
description: Keeps each tool as a row of the `tools` table in the SQLite `Store`, with its damage report as `damage_note` and `damage_reported_at`, both cleared once repaired; a CHECK keeps `condition` to `good` or `needs_repair`. `insertTool`, `findTool`, `listTools` (in ID order) and `setToolCondition` read and write it, and each command runs them in `transaction()`.

title: Store.findLoan
description: Keeps each loan as a row of the `loans` table in the SQLite `Store`, with its return as `returned_at`, `return_condition` and `return_note`; CHECKs keep `due_date` a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and `return_condition` to `good` or `needs_repair`. `insertLoan`, `findLoan`, `activeLoansForMember`, `activeLoanForTool` and `markReturned`, which touches only an active loan, run in `transaction()` so a check and its write happen together.
